name: What is the difference between an AI Discovery File and a sitemap?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between an AI Discovery File and a sitemap?

acceptedAnswer.text: While both AI Discovery Files and sitemaps aid in website discoverability, they serve distinct purposes. A sitemap primarily lists all pages and files on a website for search engine crawlers, indicating their organization. An AI Discovery File, however, goes beyond simple listing. It provides a semantic layer of data, detailing content relationships, entity recognition, and contextual relevance, specifically optimized for AI comprehension. It tells AI models not just *what* pages exist, but *what* the content on those pages *means* in an AI-readable format.
acceptedAnswer.description: A sitemap lists pages for crawlers, while an AI Discovery File provides semantic data and content relationships specifically optimized for AI comprehension and understanding.
